text: In 3 of 4 analysed books framed by bedtime or sleep, the last page returns to the opening place (the bed or bedroom) at low intensity (1-2 of 5) after a peak earlier in the book (Good Night, Monu; Bathtub Safari; Zuko and the crying tap); Bohlale's adventure wakes in the same bedroom but ends on a high payoff (4 of 5). Evidence: 3 of 4 works, small sample, confidence LOW. Proposal for `beat_sequences`: For bedtime blueprints only: place the emotional peak no later than about two thirds through, and let the final page return to the opening setting (bed, room, window) at the lowest intensity of the story.
